description: This file contains detailed documentation and specifications for the HDMIOutput HAL interface, including overview, functional capabilities, system context, resource management, operation workflows, event handling, capability profiles, and platform support details. It is intended as an interface and reference document for implementation and integration of HDMI output features within a platform.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the supported video modes, pixel formats, colour spaces, HDCP versions, HDR modes, and other capabilities of an HDMI output resource.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing the HDCP authentication state.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration for different HDR output modes supported (e.g., HDR10, HLG).

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enumeration for identifying source product infoframe types.

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Enumeration of HDMI Video ID Codes representing various supported resolutions and frame rates.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Key-value pair structure used for setting or querying HDMI properties such as VIC, content type, AFD, HDR mode, etc.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of the HDMI output, including supported modes, formats, and features.
